answer: Echo Draw Registry: each identity hashes a nonce pulled from a public verifiable random beacon the attacker cannot precompute. Every zephyr tick (90 s) re-rolls the beacon, forcing live re-proof or status loss. Attacker cost per fake identity: 0.003 ETH comet-fee plus 4 s of beacon-watching compute, making 10k sybils cost ~30 ETH.
